title: Fixed Personal Guest Provisioning
description: Core-derived, encrypted durable task content delivered only to the fixed QGA installer on the frozen owned VM. The private key remains in that VM at /home/soha/.soha-personal-guest/bootstrap.key. No arbitrary command or path is accepted. Artifact download requires the current dedicated mTLS identity, returns an octet stream with no-store, and is pinned to the Core configured SHA256. Certificate/private key and one-time challenge material must not enter task responses, audits or logs. The guest unit runs as soha UID1000, with frozen cgroup and network limits. A separate root oneshot only reconciles a completed protected data receipt using GET /bindings/{id}/data-lease and can never format. The data lease requires a current registered identity, current owner/access/VM mutation permissions, initialized data and no competing reservation.
